info.title: VariaMos Laboratory API
info.description: Contract of variamos_ms_laboratory. Requirement IDs refer to the March 2026 specification. Checked by the integration tests (src/EntryPoints/*.db.test.ts).

session.description: VariaMos session token, as a Bearer header or the authToken cookie. The account must hold the laboratory::access permission.

details.description: Problems found, e.g. why an experiment cannot become Ready.

projectId.description: VariaMos project of the experiment (LAB-EX-01); null for experiments created before projects were recorded.

name.description: Name of the original, when the user can read it.

clonedFrom.description: LAB-EX-02: the experiment and version this one was cloned from.

reproducedFrom.description: LAB-RP-01: persistent id of the run whose package rebuilt this experiment.

ownerName.description: LAB-COL-04: the researcher who created it.

SolverSettings.description: Pinned version and parameter values of one solver.

semanticsHash.description: SHA-256 of the semantics of the language pinned with the model (LAB-RP-01); null when pinned before it was kept.

pinned.description: Copy of the model, and of the semantics of its language, taken when the experiment became Ready (LAB-CF-01, LAB-RP-01, LAB-R-03).

userId.description: Author of a private metric; null for a public one.

metrics.description: Alternative to metricIds: metrics or ids.

projectId.description: VariaMos project, owned by the user or shared with them (LAB-EX-01). Required on creation.

expectedVersion.description: LAB-COL-02: the version the user started editing from; a 409 lists what others saved since.

jobId.description: Job id in the Reasoning module (LAB-RUN-03).

result.description: As returned by the Reasoning module; the mock marks its results simulated.

RunProvenance.description: What was executed, frozen when the run started (LAB-RP-02).

semanticsHash.description: Semantics pinned with the model (LAB-RP-01); absent from runs started before it was kept.

id.description: Also the job id returned to the client (LAB-RUN-03).

cancelledByName.description: Name of the user who cancelled (LAB-RUN-04).

persistentId.description: LAB-RP-03: VLAB-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX, set when the run completes.

reason.description: Why the metric could not be computed.

inputs.description: Figures the value was computed from.

simulated.description: An input came from a simulated Reasoning answer (mock gateway).

agreementRate.description: Share of answers equal to the majority of the solvers on the same scenario and run.

equivalent.description: Same results in every run, timings apart (LAB-NF-03).

Permissions.description: LAB-COL-01: what the user may do on the experiment.
